vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Graphic Component Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Graphic Component contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

vulnerabilities.name: TerraMaster OS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

vulnerabilities.name: Fortra GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.
vulnerabilities.notes: This CVE has a CISA AA located here: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a. Please see the AA for associated IOCs. Additional information is available at: https://my.goanywhere.com/webclient/DownloadProductFiles.xhtml. Fortra users must have an account in order to login and access the patch.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-0669

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle E-Business Suite Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Web Applications Desktop Integrator.

vulnerabilities.name: Multiple SugarCRM Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

vulnerabilities.name: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Insecure Direct Object Reference Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in RadAsyncUpload that can result in file uploads in a limited location and/or remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple Zoho ManageEngine products contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability due to the usage of an outdated third-party dependency, Apache Santuario.

vulnerabilities.name: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute commands via shell metacharacters in the login parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. This vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082, which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

vulnerabilities.name: TIBCO JasperReports Library Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet FortiOS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple versions of Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

vulnerabilities.name: Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway, when configured with SAML SP or IdP configuration, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code as administrator.

vulnerabilities.name: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

vulnerabilities.name: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle Fusion Middleware Access Manager allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to takeover the Access Manager product.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium GPU Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium GPU contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows CNG Key Isolation Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) Key Isolation Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Scripting Languages Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability in the JScript9 scripting language which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Samsung Mobile Devices Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Samsung mobile devices contain an improper access control vulnerability in clipboard service which allows untrusted applications to read or write arbitrary files. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25369 and CVE-2021-25370.

vulnerabilities.name: Samsung Mobile Devices Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Samsung mobile devices using Mali GPU contains an improper access control vulnerability in sec_log file. Exploitation of the vulnerability exposes sensitive kernel information to the userspace. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25337 and CVE-2021-25370.

vulnerabilities.name: Samsung Mobile Devices Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Samsung mobile devices using Mali GPU contain an incorrect implementation handling file descriptor in dpu driver. This incorrect implementation results in memory corruption, leading to kernel panic. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25337 and CVE-2021-25369.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS and iPadOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS and iPadOS kernel contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow an application to perform code execution with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows DLL Hijacking Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows interprocess communication (IPC) channel allows for insufficient validation of resources that are loaded by the application at run time. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows could execute code on the affected machine with SYSTEM privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows Uncontrolled Search Path Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

vulnerabilities.name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to upload arbitrary files using cpio package to gain incorrect access to any other user accounts.

vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform operations on the administrative interface via specially crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows COM+ Event System Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows COM+ Event System Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41040 which allows for the remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple API endpoints of Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center contain a command injection vulnerability where an attacker with access to a public Bitbucket repository, or with read permissions to a private one, can execute code by sending a malicious HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.name: Sophos Firewall Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One and Apex One as a Service
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service Improper Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service contain an improper validation of rollback mechanism components that could lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Code Aurora ACDB Audio Driver Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Code Aurora audio calibration database (acdb) audio driver contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. Code Aurora is used in third-party products such as Qualcomm and Android.

vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel Integer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Linux kernel fb_mmap function in drivers/video/fbmem.c contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows incorrectly parses shortcuts in such a way that malicious code may be executed when the operating system displays the icon of a malicious shortcut file. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could execute code as the logged-on user.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple kernel, which is included in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, contains an unspecified vulnerability where an application may be able to execute code with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium Mojo Insufficient Data Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium Mojo contains an insufficient data validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: QNAP Photo Station Externally Controlled Reference Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

vulnerabilities.name: D-Link DIR-820L Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an unspecified vulnerability involving input validation which can allow a local attacker to view sensitive user information.

vulnerabilities.name: MikroTik RouterOS Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

vulnerabilities.name: D-Link Multiple Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple D-Link routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for execution of OS commands.
vulnerabilities.action: The vendor D-Link published an advisory stating the fix under CVE-2018-20114 properly patches KEV entry CVE-2018-6530. If the device is still supported, apply updates per vendor instructions. If the affected device has since entered its end-of-life, it should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.

vulnerabilities.name: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC contain an improper access control vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain the LDAP server login credentials configured in FortiGate by pointing a LDAP server connectivity test request to a rogue LDAP server.

vulnerabilities.name: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.
vulnerabilities.action: Apply updates per vendor instructions. If the affected device has since entered end-of-life, it should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: D-Link DIR-300 Router Cleartext Storage of a Password Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The D-Link DIR-300 router stores cleartext passwords, which allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information.
vulnerabilities.action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: Android OS Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The vold volume manager daemon in Android kernel trusts messages from a PF_NETLINK socket, which allows an attacker to execute code and gain root privileges. This vulnerability is associated with GingerBreak and Exploit.AndroidOS.Lotoor.

vulnerabilities.name: dotCMS Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache CouchDB Insecure Default Initialization of Resource Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache CouchDB contains an insecure default initialization of resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to escalate to administrative privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache APISIX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apache APISIX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

vulnerabilities.name: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

vulnerabilities.name: Grafana Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

vulnerabilities.name: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.
vulnerabilities.action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: In affected versions of Apple iOS, macOS, and watchOS, a sandboxed process may be able to circumvent sandbox restrictions.

vulnerabilities.name: PEAR Archive_Tar Improper Link Resolution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

vulnerabilities.name: PEAR Archive_Tar Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: PEAR Archive_Tar allows an unserialization attack because phar: is blocked but PHAR: is not blocked. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

vulnerabilities.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Reflected Amplification Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based attacker to conduct reflected and amplified TCP denial-of-service (RDoS) attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP Multiple Products HTTP Request Smuggling Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.
vulnerabilities.notes: SAP users must have an account in order to login and access the patch. https://accounts.sap.com/saml2/idp/sso;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-22536

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution when processing malicious crafted web content.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium Intents Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium Intents contains an insufficient validation of untrusted input vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to browse to a malicious website via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Runtime Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Runtime contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.

vulnerabilities.name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when Microsoft Windows MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application.

vulnerabilities.name: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.
vulnerabilities.notes: Vulnerability updated with version 6.12. Accessing link will download update information: https://www.rarlab.com/rar/rarlinux-x32-612.tar.gz;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-30333

vulnerabilities.name: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

vulnerabilities.name: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Client Server Runtime Subsystem (CSRSS) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows CSRSS contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation to SYSTEM privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows LSA Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Windows Local Security Authority (LSA) contains a spoofing vulnerability where an attacker can coerce the domain controller to authenticate to the attacker using NTLM.
vulnerabilities.action: Apply remediation actions outlined in CISA guidance [https://www.cisa.gov/guidance-applying-june-microsoft-patch].
vulnerabilities.notes: WARNING: This update is required on all Microsoft Windows endpoints but if deployed to domain controllers without additional configuration changes the update breaks PIV/CAC authentication. Read CISA implementation guidance carefully before deploying to domain controllers.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-26925

vulnerabilities.name: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

vulnerabilities.name: Google Chromium PopupBlocker Security Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium PopupBlocker contains an insufficient policy enforcement vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to bypass navigation restrictions via a crafted iframe. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple iOS and iPadOS Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

vulnerabilities.description: A use-after-free vulnerability in Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS could allow a malicious application to execute code with system privileges.

vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Word. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability can run code with the privileges of the calling application.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver contains a vulnerability that allows unrestricted file upload.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The Universal Worklist Configuration in SAP NetWeaver AS JAVA 7.4 allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive user information via a crafted HTTP request.

vulnerabilities.description: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

vulnerabilities.description: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

vulnerabilities.description: QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

vulnerabilities.name: QNAP Photo Station Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

vulnerabilities.description: A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface of certain Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers could allow an attacker to execute code with root privileges.

This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

vulnerabilities.name: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Double Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. vulnerabilities.description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: SaltStack Salt Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.name: SaltStack Salt Shell Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains an unspecified vulnerability in BC-BMT-BPM-DSK which allows remote, authenticated users to conduct XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP Solution Manager Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

vulnerabilities.name: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

vulnerabilities.name: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.

vulnerabilities.name: SolarWinds Orion Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

vulnerabilities.name: SolarWinds Serv-U Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager allows for privilege escalation through leveraging a misconfiguration of sudo.

vulnerabilities.name: Sonatype Nexus Repository Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall Email Security Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall Email Security Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

vulnerabilities.name: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

vulnerabilities.name: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

vulnerabilities.name: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

vulnerabilities.name: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

vulnerabilities.name: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

vulnerabilities.name: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

vulnerabilities.name: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

vulnerabilities.name: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

vulnerabilities.name: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro OfficeScan Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Multiple Products Content Validation Escape Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
vulnerabilities.name: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

vulnerabilities.name: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

vulnerabilities.name: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

vulnerabilities.name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

vulnerabilities.name: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.name: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

vulnerabilities.name: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

vulnerabilities.name: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

vulnerabilities.name: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.
